title: EUV forces a different optical architecture
caption: Strong absorption prevents ordinary transmissive lenses and air paths from serving the same role they do in longer-wavelength optics. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Short-wavelength photons
nodes.detail: EUV photons carry more energy than DUV photons.

nodes.label: Absorbing materials
nodes.detail: Most ordinary optical media strongly absorb EUV.

nodes.label: Reflective multilayers
nodes.detail: Mirrors replace transmissive lens elements.

nodes.label: Vacuum path
nodes.detail: The beam travels through a controlled low-pressure environment.

title: A laser turns tin into a light source
caption: The source creates plasma, then collects a small usable part of its emission for the scanner. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Tin droplet
nodes.detail: A prepared droplet becomes the source target.

nodes.label: Laser interaction
nodes.detail: Laser energy creates a hot emitting plasma.

nodes.label: Collector mirror
nodes.detail: The collector directs useful EUV toward the intermediate focus.

nodes.label: Debris management
nodes.detail: Source protection limits contamination of sensitive optics.

title: Every reflection performs a job and loses some light
caption: Illumination shapes the beam at the reticle; projection optics form the image on the wafer. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Illuminator
nodes.detail: Set intensity and angular distribution at the mask.

nodes.label: Reflective reticle
nodes.detail: The master pattern modulates the reflected beam.

nodes.label: Projection mirrors
nodes.detail: A sequence of mirrors forms the reduced image.

nodes.label: Exposure slit
nodes.detail: The scanned image reaches the resist-coated wafer.

title: An EUV mask is a patterned reflector
caption: Absorber geometry sits above a reflective multilayer on a stable substrate; it does not work like a transparent DUV mask. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Patterned absorber
nodes.detail: Selected regions suppress reflected light.

nodes.label: Protective cap
nodes.detail: A thin surface layer protects the mirror stack.

nodes.label: Reflective multilayer
nodes.detail: Alternating layers reinforce the useful reflection.

nodes.label: Low-expansion substrate
nodes.detail: The reticle base maintains geometric stability.

title: Move and measure a wafer without breaking vacuum
caption: Load locks, wafer stages and thermal control support imaging in the scanner's vacuum environment. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Load lock
nodes.detail: A small chamber transfers wafers across the pressure boundary.

nodes.label: Wafer stage
nodes.detail: Motion and height control place the resist surface.

nodes.label: Position metrology
nodes.detail: Feedback measures where the wafer is during scanning.

nodes.label: Thermal control
nodes.detail: Heat management limits shape and position changes.

title: Random photon arrivals become feature variation
caption: Photon counting noise is only the start: electrons and resist chemistry spread and amplify the local response. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Photon arrivals
nodes.detail: Individual absorption events occur at random locations.

nodes.label: Secondary electrons
nodes.detail: Energy spreads through nearby molecular interactions.

nodes.label: Chemical response
nodes.detail: Local reactions change development behavior.

nodes.label: Printed feature
nodes.detail: Variability can produce roughness or missing and bridged features.

title: Resist platforms balance different mechanisms
caption: Chemically amplified and metal-containing resists translate EUV absorption differently; sensitivity, resolution and defects remain coupled. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Chemically amplified resist
nodes.detail: Absorption ultimately triggers catalytic chemical change.

nodes.label: Metal-containing resist
nodes.detail: A different molecular structure changes absorption and reaction pathways.

nodes.label: Process qualification
nodes.detail: Dose, pattern quality and defect behavior decide usefulness.

title: Single exposure has a finite density range
caption: Projection capability, resist behavior and required yield jointly determine whether a layer needs additional patterning. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Optical resolution
nodes.detail: Wavelength and aperture bound the image information.

nodes.label: Resist response
nodes.detail: The material must translate the image into stable geometry.

nodes.label: Multiple patterning
nodes.detail: Additional passes divide a difficult pattern into manageable pieces.

title: Higher aperture changes more than resolution
caption: Increasing NA improves the optical resolution scale while tightening focus control and changing the mask-to-wafer imaging geometry. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Wider optical cone
nodes.detail: Larger aperture captures finer pattern information.

nodes.label: Shallower focus range
nodes.detail: Wafer flatness and focus control become more demanding.

nodes.label: Anamorphic field
nodes.detail: Unequal reduction in two directions changes exposure-field geometry.

title: A scanner is qualified twice before production use
caption: Supplier integration, shipment and installation all precede customer process qualification; delivery alone is not usable capacity. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: System integration
nodes.detail: Specialist modules are assembled and tested.

nodes.label: Modular shipment
nodes.detail: The machine is transported in major subassemblies.

nodes.label: Customer installation
nodes.detail: Reassembly aligns and conditions the equipment.

nodes.label: Process qualification
nodes.detail: The fab verifies performance before production use.

source.heading: The Machine, Its Supply Chain, and Its Economics

title: Technical capability and permission are separate gates
caption: The section's dated discussion concerns access restrictions; this conceptual diagram is not a statement of current legal eligibility. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Manufacturing capability
nodes.detail: A supplier must build the required system.

nodes.label: Export authorization
nodes.detail: Applicable rules govern whether delivery may occur.

nodes.label: Installation and support
nodes.detail: Sustained operation depends on service capability.

nodes.label: Operational access
nodes.detail: Usable capacity requires the relevant gates to be satisfied.

source.heading: Who Has EUV, and Who Is Not Allowed To

title: EUV matured through several coupled bottlenecks
caption: Reflective imaging, adequate source power and reliable production operation had to mature together over time. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Reflective imaging proof
nodes.detail: Early demonstrations establish the optical principle.

nodes.label: Source development
nodes.detail: Useful light output must become stable and sufficient.

nodes.label: Mask and process ecosystem
nodes.detail: Resists, reticles and metrology develop together.

nodes.label: Production reliability
nodes.detail: The complete system must sustain manufacturing workloads.
